summary: Frontend regression after CartContext extraction + Layout.js re-export refactor. Verified the new ModernNavbar (red 'Free shipping' banner + cream bar + hamburger left + FoeGuard SVG wordmark center + person/bag icons right) and the dark charcoal ModernFooter now render on EVERY page across the site. Tested 13 routes (/, /menu, /about, /new-to-raw, /contact, /calculator, /policies, /terms, /account, /blog, /meal-plan, /faq, /delivery) plus /menu/comfort-dinner and /checkout — all 15 routes show the modern navbar with red banner + dark footer. No legacy red navbar with circular-image logo remains anywhere. Cart flow end-to-end works: /menu -> click 'Comfort Dinner' card -> /menu/comfort-dinner renders ModernNavbar + all 4 size pills (6/12/18/24 lbs) + Ingredients accordion + Nutrition Facts accordion + Add button -> click Add -> slide cart opens with 'Your Order' header and Subtotal $26.99 -> click Checkout -> navigates to /checkout with ModernNavbar present and 'Comfort Chicken 6 lbs x 1 $26.99' line item, Subtotal $26.99 matching the unit price. Zero JavaScript page errors observed across the full sweep. The previously flagged ProductLinePage legacy-navbar inconsistency from iteration_5 is now fixed.

issues: Date input uses browser default native picker (mm/dd/yyyy) rather than a styled shadcn/calendar component — minor UX inconsistency with the rest of the modern design system.
Province dropdown uses native <select> rather than a styled dropdown — minor visual inconsistency.

action_items: Optional UX polish: replace native date input on CheckoutPage with shadcn calendar component; replace native Province <select> with styled dropdown for brand consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.js cleanly re-exports ModernNavbar/ModernFooter under legacy Navbar/Footer names — good minimal-impact refactor.
CartContext.js extraction to /contexts/CartContext.js correctly breaks the circular import; SlideCart is co-located which is acceptable for a small app but could be split into its own component file.

LandingPage.js still exports ModernNavbar/ModernFooter and is ~1200 lines — recommend extracting these into /components/ModernNavbar.js and /components/ModernFooter.js so Layout.js does not need to import from a page file (architectural smell: components imported from a page module).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cart context now lives at /app/frontend/src/contexts/CartContext.js (CartProvider, useCart, SlideCart). Layout.js re-exports ModernNavbar/ModernFooter from LandingPage.js as Navbar/Footer so every legacy page imports the new modern UI. All 15 routes verified to use the modern cream navbar with the SVG FoeGuard wordmark. The unit price for 6lb Comfort Chicken is $26.99 (used for the subtotal regression assertion). Checkout uses native browser date+select pickers — outside this iteration's scope but worth aligning later.
